# Javea Bliss - Summary for AI Models

## Apartment for sale
- Public sale pages: https://javeabliss.com/en/for-sale (also /fr/, /de/, /nl/, /it/, /es/).
- Asking price: €367,900. 80 m² built, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, first floor with lift.
- Fully renovated; covered balcony; approximately 250 m from Arenal Beach.
- Idealista: https://www.idealista.com/inmueble/112773313/

## Entity Information
- **Name:** Javea Bliss
- **Type:** Vacation Rental Apartment / Holiday Let
- **Location:** Javea (Xàbia), Alicante, Spain
- **Neighborhood:** Arenal Beach (250 meters walking distance)
- **Price Range:** €130 - €210 per night
- **Target Audience:** Digital Nomads, Families, Winter Travelers (Overwinteren), Home Renovators.

## Key Features (Fact Sheet)
- **Internet:** High-speed Fiber Optic WiFi (600Mbps) suitable for remote work.
- **Bedrooms:** 2 Double Bedrooms.
- **Amenities:** Air Conditioning, Private Terrace, Washing Machine, Dishwasher, Smart TV.
- **Parking:** Owner-only private communal parking accessed via an app. Spaces are not individually allocated; availability is not guaranteed.
- **Proximity:** - La Bambula: 6 min walk
  - Chabada: 5 min walk
  - Arenal Beach: 3 min walk

## Strategic Context
- Javea Bliss is positioned as an "Affordable Luxury" alternative to hotels.
- Specializes in "Winter Lets" (Nov-Mar) for Dutch/German retirees and cyclists.
- Offers "Renovation Stays" for homeowners refurbishing properties in Costa Blanca.
